create_lora_adapter: create a LoRAAdapter instance with a uid, config, base hf config, load config, and lora backend
initialize_lora_weights: initialize LoRA adapter weights from a model checkpoint path using DefaultModelLoader
initialize_weights_from_tensors: initialize LoRA adapter weights from a dictionary of pre-loaded torch tensors
normalize_lora_weights: normalize LoRA adapter weights by fusing qkv_proj, gate_up_proj, and fused qkv_a projections
pin_lora_weights_in_cpu: pin all LoRA adapter layer, embedding, and added token weights to CPU pinned memory
